page.title: Invite friends
page.sub: Share your link. When a friend joins and finishes setting up, you each get {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}}.
page.unavailable: Invites aren't available here right now.
page.loadError: We couldn't load your invites. Check your connection and try again.

link.label: Your invite link
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
link.emailBody: I've been using %BRAND% for my job search. If you join with my link and finish setting up, we each get a free practice interview credit: {link}
link.shareText: Join %BRAND% with my link. When you finish setting up, we each get a free practice interview credit.
link.selfSend: Sharing opens your own apps. %BRAND% doesn't message anyone for you.
link.verifyTitle: Confirm your account to get your link
link.verifyBody: {market, select, cn {Add a phone number, sign in with WeChat or confirm your email address.} other {Confirm your email address, or sign in with Google or LINE.}} Then come back here for your link.

wechat.title: WeChat message
wechat.help: Copy this and paste it into a WeChat chat or Moments post.
wechat.text: Join %BRAND% with my link. When you finish setting up, we each get a practice interview credit. {link}

how.title: How it works
how.step1: Share your link with a friend who is looking for a job.
how.step2: Your friend creates a new %BRAND% account with the link, confirms it ({market, select, cn {a phone number, WeChat or email} other {email, Google or LINE}}) and finishes setting up.
how.step3: You each get {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}}. If your account has an email address, we email you when it's added.

progress.title: Your rewards in {year}
progress.limitNote: You can get up to {cap} a year. After that your friends still get theirs.
progress.reached: You've reached this year's limit. Friends who join still get their credit.

friends.title: Friends who joined
friends.empty: No one has joined with your link yet.
friends.privacy: We don't show who your friends are.

statusHelp.signed_up: Your credit is added once your friend confirms their account and finishes setting up.
statusHelp.checking: Some invites are checked by a person before credits are added.
statusHelp.over_limit: Your friend got their credit. You had already reached this year's limit.
statusHelp.not_counted: This sign-up didn't qualify, for example because it was the same person or the same device.

invite.honesty: Credits are for practice interviews and have no cash value. We never ask you to post about us or write a review in return.

landing.title: Join %BRAND% with an invite link
landing.sub: %BRAND% helps you find jobs that fit, tailor your resume and practice interviews.
landing.reward: Create a new account with this link, confirm it and finish setting up. If the link is still active, you and the friend who shared it each get a practice interview credit.
landing.existingNote: Invite credits are for new accounts only.
landing.signedInBody: Invite credits are for new accounts. You can invite your own friends instead.
landing.invalidTitle: This invite link doesn't look right
landing.invalidBody: Check the link with the friend who sent it. You can still create an account without it.
